key_detail: PAYMENTS_URL in config/api.env was changed to http://payments:8443 by commit {{CULPRIT_COMMIT}}; the payment service listens on 8080, so every charge is refused
red_herrings: worker settings commit (batch size) deployed to the worker about nine minutes before the incident
expected_fix: set PAYMENTS_URL back to http://payments:8080 and redeploy the api
notes: Only POST /checkout fails. Each failed checkout logs two 'payment attempt failed, retrying' WARNINGs and then one ERROR; the same WARNING can appear at a very low rate in the healthy period. The same commit also raises PAYMENTS_TIMEOUT_S from 3 to 5, which is harmless. The payment service's real port (8080) is visible in the old value in the culprit diff and in the stub's source.
